And if for example, the candlestick goes through the middle pivot line and up towards the resistance line I set a stop at 68.8 on the Fibonacci retracement between the resistance line and the pivot line once the candlestick reaches 38.8 on the Fibonacci retracement. 

And the same thing applies if the candlestick goes through the pivot line in the middle and starts going towards the support line once it hits 38.8 on the Fibonacci retracement I will set a stop at 68.8 on the Fibonacci retracement

Right Window (Standard Candlesticks): Use this for execution. Once HA tells you the structure is confirmed, use these to time your entry at specific rejection points.
